Module Contents¶

nvitk.gui.tools.panel._collect_params(widget: Any, tool_id: str) → dict[str, Any]¶

Read the current values of tool_id’s parameter widgets off widget into a plain dict (layer-picker params are coerced to their layer-name string).

nvitk.gui.tools.panel._set_param_visibility(widget: Any, tool_id: str) → None¶

Show only the parameter widgets on widget that tool_id actually uses; hide the rest of the shared parameter pool.

nvitk.gui.tools.panel._LAYER_NONE = '(none)'¶
nvitk.gui.tools.panel._update_reference_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) → None¶

Refresh every reference/barrier/mask layer-picker widget on widget with the viewer’s current layer names, adding a “(none)” option for the optional pickers and re-validating each widget’s current selection against the new choice list.

nvitk.gui.tools.panel._prefill_vessel_cross_section_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) → None¶

Default CD layer dropdown from the active layer (centerline = active layer).

nvitk.gui.tools.panel._update_phase_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) → None¶

Alias for _update_reference_layers(), kept for call sites conceptually refreshing per-phase layer pickers.
